inputs.text: They’re using Terry Pheto as a convenient focal point for the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a committee briefing and an SIU probe don’t prove the public is getting the whole story. They may simply be the institutions controlling the narrative. Keep the spotlight on one person, and attention stays off the institutions—and whoever benefits from that.
